checklist.title: Verify ExecutionPayloadHeader Caching: Does state.latest_execution_payload_header accurately reflect all fields of the accepted execution payload after process_execution_payload succeeds?

reachability.notes: If the cached header does not match the payload, subsequent parent_hash checks (PROP-0025) would use incorrect values, breaking execution payload chaining.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the process_execution_payload function and locate where state.latest_execution_payload_header is updated. 2. Enumerate all fields in ExecutionPayload and verify each has a corresponding field in ExecutionPayloadHeader. 3. Trace the header derivation logic to verify field-by-field mapping correctness. 4. Design test cases with varying execution payloads and verify the cached header matches: (a) parent_hash, (b) fee_recipient, (c) state_root, (d) receipts_root, (e) logs_bloom, (f) prev_randao, (g) block_number, (h) gas_limit, (i) gas_used, (j) timestamp, (k) extra_data, (l) base_fee_per_gas, (m) block_hash, (n) transactions_root, (o) withdrawals_root. 5. Attempt to falsify by checking if any field transformation or hashing (e.g., transactions to transactions_root) could produce incorrect values. 6. Verify cascading effect: submit a subsequent block and confirm parent_hash validation uses the correctly cached header.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0049, Post-condition verification for execution payload header caching. Critical for maintaining execution payload chain integrity. Failure would cause cascading validation failures in subsequent blocks.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the fork digest properly validated against the expected fork digest for the block's epoch during P2P gossip validation?

reachability.notes: A P2P peer can send blocks with arbitrary fork digests. If fork digest validation is missing, blocks from different fork versions could be processed as if they belong to the current fork.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the gossip validation handler for incoming beacon blocks (typically in beacon_processor or similar P2P message handling code). 2. Locate where fork digest is extracted from the incoming block message. 3. Verify that compute_fork_digest is called with the block's epoch to derive the expected fork digest. 4. Confirm that the received fork digest is compared against the computed expected fork digest. 5. Attempt to send a block with a mismatched fork digest (e.g., from a previous fork like Capella when Deneb is active) and verify it is rejected during gossip validation. 6. Check edge cases: blocks at fork transition boundaries, blocks with fork digests from future forks, blocks with invalid/malformed fork digests. 7. Verify rejection happens early in gossip validation before any expensive operations (signature verification, state access).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0050, Trust Boundaries: tb-004, tb-010, Primary Element: SG-003. This is a critical P2P boundary check. A missing or incorrect fork digest validation could allow blocks from incompatible fork versions to be processed under wrong consensus rules or blob limits. Defense in depth exists (block signatures, state transition validation) but early rejection is essential for DoS protection and protocol correctness.

checklist.title: Verify compute_fork_digest is correctly invoked with block's epoch during gossip validation

reachability.notes: A P2P peer can send blocks with arbitrary fork digests. If fork digest validation is missing, blocks from different fork versions could be processed as if they belong to the current fork.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate the compute_fork_digest function implementation. 2. Trace all call sites in the gossip validation path. 3. Verify the epoch parameter passed to compute_fork_digest is derived from the incoming block's slot (slot / SLOTS_PER_EPOCH). 4. Check that the genesis_validators_root used is the correct one for the network. 5. Verify the fork version lookup correctly maps the epoch to the expected fork version (Phase0, Altair, Bellatrix, Capella, Deneb, Electra). 6. Test with blocks at exact fork transition slots to ensure correct fork version is selected.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0050, Supporting check for primary boundary validation. Incorrect epoch derivation or fork version lookup could cause valid blocks to be rejected or invalid blocks to be accepted.
